shells.notes: Starlink primary belt. Fast atmospheric drag, delta_D >> delta_S. Lower long-term cascade risk due to fast self-cleaning.
Most historically congested shell. Iridium-Cosmos collision (2009) occurred at 789 km. Fengyun-1C ASAT (2007) at 865 km. Moderate drag.
Very slow atmospheric drag. Debris persists for decades. Highest long-term Kessler cascade risk. Some researchers argue this altitude is already past the mathematical point of no return.

metadata.source: Order-of-magnitude estimates from Kessler & Cour-Palais (1978) and MOCAT literature. TO BE CALIBRATED against pySSEM outputs in Phase 2.
